plugins.name: all
plugins.description: Install every plugin in this marketplace.

plugins.name: release-please
plugins.description: Skills for googleapis/release-please-action: `/repo-use-release-please` sets a repository up to release with it, `/merge-and-release-please` merges a pull request and the release pull request that follows.

plugins.name: save-last-response
plugins.description: Save Claude's final response to ~/.claude/last_responses/<session id>.md every time Claude stops.

plugins.name: worktree-prefix
plugins.description: Name `claude -w` worktree branches <prefix><name>, with the prefix taken from `git config miscClaudePlugins.worktreePrefix`.
